newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.

text.p: * Digital Equipment Corp reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.27, compared to $0.74 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.24. The stock closed at 26-1/8.
* New York Times Co is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.53, compared to $0.33 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 43.
* Reebok International Ltd is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $0.65, compared to $0.64 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 46.
* KeyCorp is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $0.97 compared to $0.88 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 49-3/4.
* Bankers Trust New York Corp is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $1.85 compared to $1.51 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 75.
* Occidental Petroleum Corp is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $0.43, unchanged from the year-ago period. The stock closed at 22-1/2.
* Silicon Graphics Inc is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.27, compared to $0.31 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 17-3/8.
